::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 29th [1886]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 153-4
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)

I think I had better glance over [the Shells](cmy_books/cmybook_357.qmd).

I have begun upon [the flowers](cmy_books/cmybook_17.qmd) but I find there must be a great revolution there, as it is no use in these days to teach the old Linnean system. I can manage by transposition, but it will take some time to set it in order, and I think it had better come in time for the spring, as it starts with the flowers of the months.

I do not think ‘Householders’ need as much retouching, but I only have it in the magazine, and could look it over better in the pages to be printed from.[^1]  

I have been waiting to hear what the Liverpool lady says to the downfall of her plans - but she has not written.

My present idea is to put [the history of the Reign](cmy_books/cmybook_189.qmd) into the [Monthly Packet](organizations/other_52.qmd) and then publish it after wards if there seems an opening, but I have not yet had her answer so that I cannot quite decide.[^2]

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: CMY was trying to get 'Householders' and *The Herb of the Field* republished.
[^2]: The unnamed Liverpool lady had encouraged CMY to write the book which appeared as *Victorian Half-Century*.
